global_style: A sophisticated, editorial-style presentation featuring a Morandi color palette, grainy organic background shapes, botanical shadow overlays, and elegant serif typography.

identity_anchors: Floating central white content cards with soft drop shadows
Textured, grainy organic blob shapes spanning backgrounds
Photorealistic botanical/leaf shadow overlays on edges
Signature three-dot decorative accent (rust, sand, mustard) placed near titles

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
